summary: Frontend E2E testing of Iteration-3 new features: Wishlist Drawer and Coupon Calculator. Executed 12 scenario groups covering empty state, hearting products, add-to-bag from wishlist, view→modal handoff, remove/localStorage sync, add-all, close mechanisms (button/Escape/backdrop), coupon nudge vs applied banner, discount math, WhatsApp checkout payload (with & without coupon), mobile viewport behaviour, toast positioning, and sanity check of catalog (16 items) & product modal. 35 of 36 assertions passed. Only failure: mobile header — LUMIÈRE logo text overlaps search icon by ~5px at 390×844.

issues: LUMIÈRE centered logo (absolute left-1/2) right-edge is at x≈251 while search icon left-edge starts at x≈246 — a ~5px visual overlap. All three right-side icons (search/wishlist heart/bag) do not overlap the logo per acceptance criteria (they must sit to the right of the logo's right edge). Header renders otherwise but should either shrink the LUMIÈRE mark, tighten `tracking`, or hide the search icon on very small viewports to eliminate collision. Wishlist heart (x≈286) and bag (x≈326) are clear; only the search icon collides.

verified_scenarios: Empty wishlist: header-wishlist-count absent, wishlist-empty shown, wishlist-browse-btn closes drawer and scrolls to catalog
Hearting 2 products → header-wishlist-count=2, wishlist-count-label='2 pieces', both wishlist-item-* rendered
wishlist-add-to-bag-LUM-RN-01 → header-bag-count=1, item still in wishlist
wishlist-view-LUM-PD-02 closes drawer and opens product-modal with modal-title='Classic Teardrop Solitaire Pendant'
wishlist-remove-LUM-RN-01 removes item, header-wishlist-count decrements to 1, localStorage lumiere_wishlist=['LUM-PD-02'], grid button aria-pressed=false
wishlist-add-all-btn adds both items to bag (bag increased by 2)
wishlist-close-btn, Escape key, and backdrop-click all dismiss the drawer
Coupon: 1 item → coupon-nudge-banner shown, bag-discount-line absent, bag-total=₹1,299
Coupon: qty=2 (same item, ₹1,299×2) → coupon-applied-banner shown, bag-subtotal=₹2,598, bag-discount=-₹260, bag-total=₹2,338
Decrement qty back to 1 → nudge banner returns, bag-total=₹1,299
Coupon: 2 different items (LUM-RN-01 + LUM-PD-02) → subtotal=₹1,998, discount=-₹200, total=₹1,798
WhatsApp checkout w/ 2 items: url starts with https://wa.me/919112299902?text=, decoded text contains 'Coupon LUXE10', '-₹200', 'Grand Total: ₹1,798 INR'
WhatsApp checkout w/ 1 item: no 'Coupon' line, 'Grand Total: ₹1,299 INR'
Mobile (390×844): wishlist drawer opens as bottom sheet (y≈583)
Mobile: toast after quick-add appears at y≈92 (below header-bottom≈57); header-bag-btn remains clickable immediately
Sanity: catalog count '(16)' and 16 product-card-* elements; product-card click opens product-modal
No console errors observed during full run
critical_code_review_comments: AnimatePresence around header-wishlist-count / header-bag-count can render two elements during transition — tests must use .first. Not a functional bug but noted for stable selectors.
Mobile header layout: absolute-centered logo can collide with right-icon cluster when 3 icons are present. Consider hiding search icon on <sm or using flex layout instead of absolute centering.
action_items: (Design) Fix mobile header collision at 390px: LUMIÈRE logo right edge overlaps search icon by ~5px. Options: shrink tracking on <sm, hide search-toggle-btn on mobile, or use flex justify-between with logo in normal flow instead of absolute centering.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iterations 1-3 features are stable. Wishlist Drawer + Coupon Calculator (LUXE10) fully verified including WhatsApp payload. Only outstanding item is a minor mobile header layout collision — verify visually after fix. When asserting count badges, always use `.first` since AnimatePresence briefly renders old+new. Bag item keys follow `{id}__{metal}__{size}`; default is `{id}__18K Gold__<firstSize>`.
